facts.l: sessions in a course, 2–3 a week

situations.title: When strain builds up faster than it fades
situations.lede: An ozone bath is not a once-a-year treat. It is a session for the recovery you need every week.

items.title: After training
items.text: Running, the gym or padel — you plan the load. Here you can plan the recovery too.

items.title: After a day on your feet
items.text: A shift in a shop, salon or clinic. Warmth and massage that leave the body feeling lighter.

items.title: After a week at the desk
items.text: Calls, screens, tight shoulders. 30 minutes when your body has nothing to do.

items.title: In the dark months
items.text: When Riga gets dark in the afternoon — warmth, light and 30 minutes for yourself twice a week.

process.title: Five steps, no surprises
process.lede: You know what happens at every moment — and you can always say if something isn't comfortable.

steps.title: A short talk
steps.text: We ask how you feel and whether you have any health limitations. If the session isn't right for you, we will tell you honestly.

steps.title: Choosing the length
steps.text: Together we choose 20 or 30 minutes and a water temperature that feels pleasant to you.

steps.title: The ozone bath
steps.text: Ozone is added to the warm water, so it fizzes like mineral water. You feel a light tingle of bubbles on your skin.

steps.title: Massage — optional
steps.text: After the bath — a massage with ozonated oil. Warmth and massage help the muscles relax.

steps.title: No rush
steps.text: There is no need to hurry afterwards. During a course you note how you feel on your Recovery card.

process.caption: The water fizzes like mineral water — this is what an ozone bath looks like.

feel.title: Sensations, not promises
feel.lede: We don't promise miracles and we don't treat anything. Here is how you may feel during the session and after it. Everyone feels it differently.

items.text: Warmth and a light tingle of bubbles. The body grows heavy and relaxed.
Often — a lighter body and a calmer head.
Recovery becomes a habit, and you see how you feel on your Recovery card.

feel.note: A wellness procedure, not a medical service. It does not replace a doctor's advice or treatment.

course.title: 10 sessions. Your recovery plan.
course.lede: One session is an introduction. Regular recovery is a course: 2–3 times a week for 4–5 weeks, with one specialist.
points: You get fixed days and times
The price of your first session counts towards the course if you buy it within 14 days
A Recovery card — you rate your own progress
course.card_sub: Before sessions 1, 5 and 10 you rate yourself from 1 to 10:
course.card_note: Nobody promises you numbers — you write them in yourself.

prices.title: Clear prices, no promotions
prices.lede: For your first visit we suggest the 45-minute session with massage — it shows best how the full session feels.

specialist.text: We opened recently, so every client gets personal attention. Nikolajs runs every session himself: he talks with you first, chooses the right length and makes sure you are comfortable.

specialist.img_alt: Nikolajs Jakovļevs, massage and ozone bath specialist

before.title: The session is not for everyone
before.text: When booking, tell us about your health — for example pregnancy, chronic conditions, recent surgery or how you feel that day. If the session isn't right for you, we will say so. If in doubt, please talk to a doctor first.

items.a: A wellness procedure: you lie in warm water to which ozone is added, so the water fizzes like mineral water. The session is run by a certified specialist.

items.q: What should I choose for my first visit?
items.a: We suggest the 45-minute session — the bath with massage. If you are short on time, start with a 20- or 30-minute bath.
For regular recovery we suggest a course: 10 sessions, 2–3 times a week, for about 4–5 weeks.

items.q: Can I combine it with training?
items.a: Yes. Tell the specialist about your training load and he will adjust the length of the session.
No. It is a wellness procedure and does not replace a doctor's advice, diagnosis or treatment.
Stirnu iela 8, 2nd floor, room 203 (in the ĀRC VALEO building), Riga.
